Les expressions de la vie au collège : être à l'heure, avoir son bulletin, passer en classe supérieure… Comme dans la Lesson 1, apprends l'expression et son explication en anglais. Expression — Meaning — En français To line up — To queue up. — se mettre en rang To be late — ≠ To be on time. — être en retard ≠ être à l'heure To receive a report — To receive a school report. — recevoir son bulletin To be top of — To be the best of. — être le premier / la meilleure de Well done — Nice job, or very good.

notions.titre: Les contraires à retenir par paires
notions.texte: to be late ≠ to be on time to be top of the class ≠ to be bottom of the class to go up ≠ to stay down

The students line up in front of the classroom. Karniella is never late. She is always on time. She works hard, so she is top of the class. She receives her school report: well done! She goes up to 4e.
Chaque ligne a un bouton 🔊. Attention à queue : on dit simplement « kiou », les lettres « ue » ne se prononcent pas.

notions.titre: Expressing an action in progress with: the present continuous
notions.texte: Le présent continu sert à dire ce qu'on est en train de faire, en ce moment même.

Subject + BE (am / is / are) + verb-ING + object Subject — BE — Example I — am — I am writing on the board. You — are — You are speaking English. He / She / It — is — She is lining up. We / You / They — are — They are working hard. Dans ton cahier : I am writing on the board. (I = sujet) You are speaking English. (You = sujet)
Oublier BE : I writing → I am writing. Oublier -ING : You are speak → You are speaking. Rappel de la Lesson 1 : le e final tombe (write → writing) et certaines consonnes doublent (swim → swimming).
Cherche d'abord seule, à voix haute si tu peux. Ensuite, ouvre la correction.

Donne l'explication en anglais. To stay down means… … To go up means… … To line up means… … To work hard means… … To be top of means… … To repeat the class. To go to the next class. To be the best of.
Donne le contraire. to be top of ≠ … to be bottom of
Complète avec am, is ou are. I … writing on the board. The students … lining up. Karniella … working hard. We … speaking English. The teacher … reading the reports.

notions.titre: Exercise 4 — Put the verb in the present continuous
notions.texte: She (write) … a letter. They (play) … in the playground. I (read) … my school report. You (sit) … next to the window. She is writing a letter. They are playing in the playground. I am reading my school report. You are sitting next to the window. (sit → sitting : le t double)
I writing on the board. You are speak English. They is lining up. I am writing on the board. You are speaking English. They are lining up.

Lis à voix haute, puis raconte ta propre journée des bulletins. Teacher: Line up, please! I am giving the school reports. Teacher: Karniella, you are top of the class. Well done! Karniella: Thank you, sir! I am working hard. Teacher: You are going up to 4e. Nobody is staying down this year! sir : monsieur (au professeur) ; madam : madame nobody : personne this year : cette année
Le vocabulaire de la vie au collège et le présent continu.

quiz.question: To line up means…
quiz.explication: To line up = to queue up (se mettre en rang).

quiz.question: What is the opposite of « to be late »?
quiz.explication: To be late ≠ to be on time.

quiz.question: To stay down means…
options: To go to the next class
quiz.explication: To stay down = to repeat the class (redoubler).

quiz.question: To go up means…
options: To go to the next class
quiz.reponse: To go to the next class
quiz.explication: To go up = to go to the next class.

quiz.question: To be top of the class means…
options: To be the worst of the class
To be the best of the class
quiz.reponse: To be the best of the class
quiz.explication: To be top of = to be the best of. The opposite: to be bottom of.

quiz.question: « Well done! » means…
quiz.explication: Well done = nice job, very good.

quiz.question: To work hard means…
quiz.explication: To work hard = to work a lot.

quiz.question: Comment dit-on « recevoir son bulletin » ?
quiz.explication: To receive a report = to receive a school report.

quiz.question: The present continuous expresses…
quiz.explication: Expressing an action in progress: what you are doing now.

quiz.question: Complete: I ___ writing on the board.
quiz.explication: I am writing on the board.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence.
quiz.explication: Subject + BE + verb-ing: You are speaking English.

quiz.question: Negative form of « She is lining up »:
quiz.explication: Subject + BE + NOT + verb-ing: she isn't lining up.
